subtitle: Completed 2025 year in review — roundtables, the 5th Symposium, new groups and partnerships, and the transition to 2026 governance.
audience: Members, participants, collaborators, and the public who want a consolidated view of the Institute's year in 2025.
lede: 2025 was the Active Inference Institute's fifth full year: four Quarterly Roundtables, the 5th Applied Active Inference Symposium (November 12–14), the Theoretical Neurobiology Group joining the Institute, a new RxInfer.jl partnership, completion of the Project ~ Measurement system, and selection of the 2026 Board — a completed year in review, organized month by month. The detailed record continues to be maintained on the 2025 hub.

sections.heading: A Year in Review
sections.body:
2025 closed with the Institute's fifth Applied Active Inference Symposium and a completed governance cycle. This retrospective maps the year month by month: new groups hosted (Theoretical Neurobiology), a new partnership (RxInfer.jl Learning Group), four Quarterly Roundtables, the Project ~ Measurement system, and the selection of 2026 leadership.

For the Institute's longer arc, see the History page; for the year that followed, see 2026.

sections.heading: January
sections.body: Institute Programs and Activities begin for the year. The Theoretical Neurobiology (TNB) Group is now hosted at the Institute.

sections.heading: February
sections.body: A new partnership begins, collaborating on the RxInfer.jl Learning Group and elsewhere.

sections.heading: July
sections.body: Summer break. The Institute completes the Project ~ Measurement system so that Projects stay in an active state.

sections.heading: November
sections.body:
November 12–14 — 5th Applied Active Inference Symposium. Recruitment opens for the next year's Board of Directors and Scientific Advisory Board.

Projects mostly finish up after the Symposium.

sections.heading: December
sections.body:
December 19 — 2025 Quarterly Roundtable #4. The Institute continues to review Strategy, Mission, Vision, Values, and Principles, along with Ecosystem Support, Philanthropy, Grants, and more.

The Board of Directors for 2026 is selected, and applications open for the Scientific Advisory Board for 2026.

sections.heading: Full materials
sections.body: The complete archival record of 2025 goals, milestones, and events — as they were tracked during the year — is maintained on the 2025 hub and is being migrated onto this site.

cards.title: Quarterly Roundtables
cards.text: Four 2025 Quarterly Roundtables (March 28, June 27, September 26, December 19) communicate quarterly expectations and results.

cards.title: 5th Applied Active Inference Symposium
cards.text: November 12–14 — the year's flagship event, after which projects mostly finish up.

cards.title: Governance for 2026
cards.text: The 2026 Board of Directors is selected and Scientific Advisory Board applications open.

cards.title: Newsletter
cards.text: Monthly newsletters covered Institute and Ecosystem activity throughout 2025.
